description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of intelligent navigation instances for the current tenant
description_zh: 分页获取当前租户下智能导航实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun voicenavigator list-instances --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --nlu-service-type-list-json-string CCC_AUTHORIZED --union-source CCC --union-instance-id zhyl --name '测试' --status PUBLISHED --number 021xxxxxxx --instance-id-list-json-string e4bebxxxxxxxxxxx --api-version 2018-06-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstances

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The NLU type used to filter by dialog capability source. If this parameter is not specified, all types are selected.

MANAGED: managed (deprecated).

AUTHORIZED: authorized. In the public cloud, this refers to Chatbot service.

PROVIDED: private. Configured by specifying the AccessKey ID, AccessKey Secret, and chatEndpoint in the O&M console.
CCC_AUTHORIZED: uses a Chatbot authorized by Cloud Call Center.

CCC_FUNCTION: uses Alibaba Cloud Function Compute.

SSE_FUNCTION: uses a streaming function service. Function Compute that supports SSE, used to connect to third-party large language model chatbots.


PROMPTS: connects to Qwen foundation models.

LOCAL: private cloud, local Chatbot
parameters.help_zh:
nlu类型,对话能力来源筛选条件。不填则全选。

MANAGED：托管【已废弃】

AUTHORIZED：授权，公共云：智能对话机器人服务

PROVIDED：私有， 通过在运维控制台配置as、sk、以及chatEndpoint等。
CCC_AUTHORIZED：使用云联络中心授权的小蜜机器人

CCC_FUNCTION：使用阿里函数计算服务

SSE_FUNCTION：使用流式函数服务 ，支持SSE的函数计算，用于对接三方大模型对话机器人


PROMPTS：对接qwen基模等

LOCAL：专有云，本地基蜜
